# Conversation Tree (dsh-conversation-tree)
English | 中文
**Turn DSH's conversation list into a living tree — file every conversation under «Workspace → Topic
→ Conversation», see the status at a glance, and let the model keep the tree tidy for you.**
> Screenshots use demo data: workspace, topic and conversation names are placeholders.
A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds a collapsible, resizable **tree band** to the left of the
conversation column. The product's own conversation column, header, Chat/Trajectory tabs, right sid
ebar and composer keep rendering exactly as before — the band reserves a strip on the left and never
replaces product UI.
## Features
| **Organise, don't replace** — Workspace → topic → conversation, with nested topics and several «sp
aces» (each one its own tree). | **Status at a glance** — every row rolls up the status of its own c
onversations and all descendants; a count clears only when you actually open the conversation. |
- **Find it again** — the in-band search covers topic titles/descriptions, indexed conversation titl

es and conversation bodies (index built on demand inside DSH).
- **Collapsed by default** — a header

icon and the sidebar panel row open the same band; the collapsed state is remembered.
- **Bilingual
UI** — Simplified Chinese and English, following **Settings → General → Language** and switching li

ve, no restart.
- **Resizable and remembered** — drag the band's right edge (minimum 320px); the con
versation column keeps its own minimum width and is never squeezed away.
## What's new in 0.3.0
- **Name a Workspace while you create it** — the `L1` column's ＋ dialog now has a «Workspace name» f
ield under the directory: it fills in from the directory's final segment and can be edited, an alrea
dy-registered directory keeps its name unless you change it, and a duplicate name is refused in the
dialog. The directory picker also stopped moving the dialog while the system panel opens.
## What's new in 0.2.0
- **The tree follows the conversation** — opening, creating or externally navigating to a conversati
on always lands the tree on that conversation's home (its topic, its Workspace row, the space's «Ung
rouped» row or its «Archived» row); ungrouped conversations no longer leave the tree on another bran

ch, and clicking a topic row stays a temporary browse that a reload forgets.
- **Archive per Workspa
ce** — every Workspace ends with an «Archived» shelf: put a topic (with its subtree and conversation
s) or a single conversation away without freezing it; archived conversations stay openable, searchab

le and continuable, and the model tools answer `ARCHIVED` instead of touching them.
- **Drag to orga
nise** — drag conversations onto topics (or a Workspace row) and topics onto each other or between s
iblings; «the topic + its conversations + its footer» is one drop target, with before/after on its 8

px edges.
- **Delete asks first** — deleting a topic confirms, then removes its whole subtree at onc

e; its conversations are kept and fall back to the Workspace top level.
- **Conversation home** — th
e home chain is always a filled brand folder with a bold title, a clicked node is a 1.5px brand outl
ine, and the composer gains a quiet 30px line naming `space › workspace › topic › conversation title

` when the selection points away.
[该节后续省略]
## Security & privacy
- **Local data only.** The authoritative document is `$DSH_HOME/conversation-map/map.json`, read and
written through the `/conversation-map` RPC channel with optimistic revision locking. The plugin ma

kes no network requests.
- **No network requests.** The plugin never calls home; the only optional n

etwork step above is `npm install` / adding the index URL, both of which you start yourself.
- **No
npm dependencies, no install scripts.** `package.json` declares no `dependencies`/`devDependencies`

and no `install`/`postinstall` script — the published `lib/` is prebuilt.
- **The nine tools only re
ad and write this tree.** They create, rename, move and file nodes and conversations in the map; the
y do not run commands, scan files or write outside it. `map_delete_nodes` deletes nodes only — conve
rsations under a deleted node fall back to the Workspace root and are never deleted. Search indexing

reads the session texts DSH already keeps locally, and stays in the Host process.
- **Degrades safe
ly.** If the product changes the DOM slots the band relies on, it shows a «temporarily unavailable»
notice instead of covering the conversation column.
## Compatibility

| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.3` (`engines.dsh`) |
| Verified on | DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` — dsh.so L5 runtime verifi

cation on npm 0.1.3; also loaded on the DSH desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` build (development link) |
| dsh.so

| L5 runtime verification on `0.2.1-rc.3`, low risk, MIT |
| Built as | prebuilt `lib/`; installing
needs no build and no toolchain |
## Known limitations
- **Depends on public product DOM contracts** (the frame `shell.overlay` slot, the conversation anch
or, the header's leading seat, the sidebar-collapsed marker). If they change, the band degrades to a

notice; the sidebar panel row keeps working.
- **Single left-band slot**: coordinates with other ba

nd plugins through the public `html[data-dsh-band-owner]` attribute.
- **Drag scope**: conversation
rows can be dropped on a topic/Workspace row, and topic rows can be re-parented or sibling-ordered (
«the topic + its conversations + its footer» is the target; its top/bottom 8px mean before/after). U
ngrouped content does not drag, cross-Workspace moves are not supported, and spaces cannot be reorde

red by dragging.
- **No cross-Workspace conversation moves**: ordering applies within one WorkSpace.
- **Single writer**: when the same `$DSH_HOME` is written by several processes, the last writer win

s.
- **Windows desktop: not independently verified** (tested on macOS).
- **Search scope**: exact su
bstring matching over titles/descriptions/bodies — no fuzzy matching, segmentation or pinyin.
